battleFormations.name: Grand Coven
battleFormations.effect: Kindred Sorcery: In your Command phase, select one (once per battle each): Imbued Manifestation (+6" range to Psychic ranged weapons), Psychic Maelstrom (+1 Wound roll on Psychic attacks), or Wrath of the Immaterium (Psychic weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]). Active until your next Command phase.

battleFormations.name: Changehost of Deceit
battleFormations.effect: Infernal Pacts: SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units gain Daemonic Illusions (4+ invuln vs ranged while near a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker); Thousand Sons units gain Mortal Sorcery (grants Cabal of Sorcerers to a nearby Scintillating Legions Psyker unit). Can include Scintillating Legions up to 500/1000/1500pts by battle size; cannot be Warlord.

battleFormations.name: Warpmeld Pact
battleFormations.effect: Warpmeld Sacrifice: TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY/MOUNTED units can sacrifice themselves (-1 Wound roll taken, or +1 Wound roll dealt) for D3 mortal wounds at end of phase. TZAANGORS gain BATTLELINE and +1 OC while not Battle-shocked.

battleFormations.name: Rubricae Phalanx
battleFormations.effect: All is Dust: Attacks with unmodified Damage 1 allocated to RUBRICAE models get +1 to the armour save.

artefacts.name: Tzeentch magic items
artefacts.effect: Enhancement named in source notes — exact rules text/cost not confirmed; check codex/Wahapedia.

artefacts.name: Lord of Forbidden Lore
artefacts.effect: [THOUSAND SONS model only] When the bearer manifests a Ritual, add 6" to its range while resolving.

artefacts.name: Incandaeum
artefacts.effect: [EXALTED SORCERER model only] Once per battle, select Doombolt even if already attempted this phase.

artefacts.name: Umbralefic Crystal
artefacts.effect: [THOUSAND SONS model only (once per battle/army)] If unengaged, place unit in Strategic Reserves with Deep Strike until your next Shooting phase; must ingress next Movement phase (incl. turn 1).

artefacts.name: Eldritch Vortex of E'taph
artefacts.effect: [THOUSAND SONS model only] +1 Strength/Damage on the bearer's Psychic weapons.

artefacts.name: Nethershriek Mind-eater
artefacts.effect: [THOUSAND SONS or LORD OF CHANGE model only] At the start of your Shooting phase, force a nearby enemy Battle-shock test; on failure, 3 mortal wounds.

artefacts.name: Diabolic Savant
artefacts.effect: [THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only] While within 6" of a friendly Scintillating Legions unit, add 1 to the Psychic test result when Channelling the Warp.

artefacts.name: Duplicitous Malediction
artefacts.effect: [THOUSAND SONS or LORD OF CHANGE model only] After deployment, redeploy up to 3 units, any to Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: Tome of True Names
artefacts.effect: [THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only] Once per battle, gain a 2+ invulnerable save for a phase.

artefacts.name: Warpmeld Dagger
artefacts.effect: [TZAANGOR SHAMAN model only] Suffer D3 mortal wounds to add 1 to the Psychic test result per wound.

artefacts.name: Diamond of Distortion
artefacts.effect: [TZAANGOR SHAMAN model only] While leading a unit, attacks against it suffer -1 to Hit.

artefacts.name: Bray Lord
artefacts.effect: [SORCERER or INFERNAL MASTER model only] The bearer gains the Scouts 6" ability.

artefacts.name: Flowing Flesh
artefacts.effect: [TZAANGOR SHAMAN model only] The bearer has Feel No Pain 4+ and a Wounds characteristic of 5.

armyRules.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
armyRules.effect: At the start of your Shooting phase, models with this ability can attempt Rituals: roll 2D6 (optionally Channel the Warp for +1D6, risking D3 mortal wounds on a double/triple); if the total meets the Ritual's Warp Charge value, it manifests. Rituals: Destiny's Ruin (WC5, re-roll Hit 1s vs a target, full re-roll if 10+), Temporal Surge (WC6, move a friendly unit D6"/6" but it can't charge), Doombolt (WC7, D3 mortal wounds, D3+3 if 11+), Twist of Fate (WC9, +1 AP vs a target, +2 if 12+).

armyRules.name: Pact of Sorcery
armyRules.effect: Unless stated otherwise, you cannot select SCINTILLATING LEGIONS as your Army Faction.
